offering_description.value: Designs and sells high-quality home furnishings, cookware, kitchen tools, furniture, decor and bedding to consumers and businesses. Products are sold through e-commerce websites, catalogs and company-owned stores under several brands. Products are mostly designed in-house and made by third-party manufacturers.

primary_products.value: furniture; cookware and kitchenware; home decor; bedding and bath; lighting and rugs

customer_segment.value: B2C: home furnishing and kitchen shoppers, families, gift and registry customers; B2B: commercial and trade customers, hospitality and design professionals

end_markets.value: home furnishings; kitchen and dining; home decor; children's furniture

revenue_model.value: product sales: home goods sold online, via catalogs and in stores

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs proprietary products made by third-party vendors, sold under own brands; retailer: sells directly to consumers via e-commerce and stores

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, Australia, UK stores and e-commerce, franchise and international partners in Middle East, Asia, Europe, Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: kitchen, furniture, decor and bedding brands sharing consumers, design and e-commerce channels

distribution_channels.value: online: brand e-commerce websites and apps, majority of sales; own locations: company-owned retail stores; direct sales: catalogs and business-to-business sales; partners / resellers: franchisees and international partners
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer product safety (CPSC), import tariffs and customs, sourcing rules, data privacy
